text:
sasha: quick capture from this morning's roadmap huddle. goal: make the launch criteria economically precise so Finance + Legal can sign off.

Tom: good call. I want two things explicit: (1) how we compute SLA credits for evictions, and (2) how we enforce cost-guardrails when cross-region routing would cause big spend delta.

isabel: SLA credit calc proposal: credit = max(0, (evicted_tenant_minutes / SLA_window_minutes) * monthly_commit_value * penalty_factor). Example: if tenant paid $10k/month reserved, SLA_window=43200min (30d), evicted 60m, penalty_factor=0.5 -> credit = (60/43200)*10000*0.5 = $6.94.

yusuf: practically we should surface estimated credit immediately in the tenant console when an eviction is enacted. customers hate surprises. Also need an audit record w/ evict_reason and affected_regions.

Tom: cost-guardrail: routing decision must compute projected token-cost-delta over next 60m. If projected_delta > tenant_budget_cap (default 10%), apply cost-aware fallback to a compatible model variant or reduce routing pct. That calculation must run in under 50ms in the routing hot path.

isabel: sample routing policy DSL snippet for precedence + fallback:
```
policies:
  - id: customer-override
    priority: 100
  - id: isolation-dedicated
    priority: 90
  - id: geo-affinity
    priority: 60
  - id: cost-fallback
    priority: 10
fallback_strategy:
  max_cost_delta_pct: 10
  variants: ["gpt-lite-quant", "gpt-medium-8q"]
```

sasha: note: conflict resolution algorithm = highest priority wins; tie -> longest-tenancy wins; still tie -> deterministic hash by tenant_id to avoid flapping. Include in spec.

yusuf: canary blast-radius calc idea: choose tenants that together represent < 0.5% of global QPS and cross-validate across model families. CLI to create canary should auto-run a "blast_radius_check" which returns pass/fail. Example CLI:
```
redwoodctl routing canary --policy isolation-v2 --tenants t1,t2 --pct 1 --duration 48h --dry-run
# returns: blast_radius=0.42% QPS, cost-delta=+3.1%, pass
```

Tom: rollout guardrails: automatic rollback if any of: 99p latency > baseline * 1.15 for 10m, error_rate > 2% for 5m, projected_cost_delta > budget for 20m, or >3 tenant-complaints in 24h. Yes, we will count complaints from the customer notifications webhook.

isabel: telemetry hooks: policy.name, action, prev_region, new_region, cost_delta_usd, sla_credit_estimate, eviction_duration_minutes, manifest_id. These must be tagged on every request at decision time.

legal: for sales/legal: we can provide an "isolation covenant (beta)" clause with explicit examples of credit calc and the pilot caveats. We need product to supply the exact SLA_window and penalty_factor constants.

sasha: proposal: SLA_window = 30d, penalty_factor default = 0.5 (configurable for enterprise deals), tenant_budget_cap default = 10% (configurable).

yusuf: ops note: KV-cache rehydration after cross-region failover is a risk. Add a small cooldown (30s) during which we RateLimit new sessions to avoid cache stampede. Also keep a metric for rehydrate_errors.

Tom: acceptance checklist for launch candidate:
- policy precedence spec published (owner: isabel, due Tue)
- SLA credit calc document + sample invoices (owner: tom, due Tue)
- canary CLI + blast_radius_check implemented (owner: yusuf, due Wed)
- telemetry wiring + dashboards (owner: isabel, due Wed)
- legal draft for beta covenant (owner: legal, due Wed)

Sasha: owners confirmed. Also: deploy-bot scheduled a smoke canary window for next Thursday 02:00-04:00 UTC (ID: canary-247890). Please link tickets in the PRD.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window created for 2026-04-09 02:00-04:00 UTC (ID: canary-247890).

sasha: thanks all. If anyone objects to the penalty_factor or default caps, raise here by EOD, otherwise we'll lock into the PRD. :white_check_mark:
